results.title: Tadej Pogacar wins a record-equalling fifth Tour de France title
Drive for five: Terra Ceia cross country has high hopes for another conference title
results.description: What do you do for an encore? If you’re Terra Ceia Christian School cross country coaches Mark and Brandi Cagle, you strive for more.

results.title: A reset in Kansas City: Andy Reid brings Chiefs rookies and QBs in early again after a 6-11 collapse
results.description: Kansas City Chiefs coach Andy Reid decided to bring rookies and quarterbacks into training camp early this year, something he had eschewed during their recent playoff seasons.

results.title: Derek McInnes drops huge update on Rangers transfer business as he reveals extent of Thelo Aasgaard injury
results.description: DEREK McINNES has revealed Rangers are closing in on TWO more targets. It’s understood the Gers boss is confident of adding a centre half AND a winger before Friday night’s Premiership opener against Dundee United. The Light Blues have signed seven new players this summer. This would take their haul to nine with McInnes pushing...

results.title: Verstappen double downs on ‘undriveable’ Red Bull despite second place finish at Hungary
results.description: Verstappen had earlier described the car as “undriveable” a comment repeated by team-mate Isack Hadjar who finished sixth.
